sections.Profile:
A heavily experimental pinball machine conceptualized by Python Anghelo, emphasizing verticality in an arcade cabinet.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1994
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Carnival, Circus, Original Theme, 1990s, Solid State, Weird Pinball Machines
